unit: One newly independently designed complex dual-platform component PR, two repair arms, one identical naturally authored initial source capsule and one shared initial capture per platform/case.
design: After tool release, fresh independent design context freezes public requirements, typed design lock, routes, native unit expectations, source-only style audit items and one hidden input scenario. At most six public checkpoints, one public route and one hidden route; enough business/state/content/style complexity to be meaningful. No adaptive task replacement after seeing outputs.
initial_author: Fresh context sees only public requirements and pinned upstreams. Implements both platforms, compile-only allowed. No screenshots or runtime feedback before source seal.

arms.manual: Frozen v9 skill; route, diagnostics and retest tools available only if present in v9 and voluntarily called. Agent may select state scopes. Common native runner coalesced and final gate identical.
arms.default: Frozen v10 skill with mandatory automatic intake routing/diagnosis/planning, same steps on each feedback and full final. Agent cannot select cases or states. No hidden evaluation disclosed.

barriers: independent public/private design and graders before authoring
initial source capsule before any render
same initial source and D0 handoff to both arms
both final sources and self claims before hidden
independent initial/final source, visual/native and alarm-cause judgments sealed before reveal

scoring.unknown: All required original atomic checks retain P/F/U including coverage/method failures. Missing evidence cannot pass. Report raw all-applicable U and mandatory-obligation U; omitted targeted states do not count as new locator faults.
scoring.product_defects: Independent evidence-grounded review of initial and both final implementations, public and hidden original contracts. Group genuine common causes; collector/host/oracle failures separate. No strict failed assertion is automatically a confirmed product defect.
scoring.quality: Residual confirmed initial defects, new regressions and unresolved attribution/unknowns. Final PR accepted only full fresh source-bound public evidence plus independent public/hidden quality and source-only mandatory audit. Lack of source runtime property observation remains explicit.
scoring.rates: Recall/miss and repair rates need nonzero confirmed real-defect denominators. False-discovery rate = confirmed false alarms / judged alarms, uncertainty separate; classic FPR requires defined true-negative opportunities and may be N/A.
scoring.success_cost: Actual authoring wall + shared D0 acquisition + repair handoff through full-public-final endpoint. Each phase, queues, service and build/capture time separate. Successful delivery cost only for accepted independent-quality-complete PRs; failed endpoints reported separately. Design/engineering/grading/barrier/publication overhead separate.
scoring.attribution: No renderer/observer scan optimization credited to treatment: both use the same coalesced native backend. Explicit new default-chain usage and resolution evidence required. No population/statistical claim from n=1.

failure_policy: Preserve failed attempts, service exceptions, all native receipts, unresolved judgments and unsuccessful delivery costs. Generic fixes after tool release require explicit amendment and invalidate primary treatment claims; no silent tuning.
